title: LamaClearItems
description: Automatic item cleanup and anti-lag utility plugin
body:
✨ **LamaClearItems** ✨

A lightweight utility plugin to keep your server clean and running smoothly

LamaClearItems automatically removes dropped items and invisible armor stands on a timer, warns players before cleanup, and includes an anti-lag system that helps detect problematic chunks when server performance drops

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⚙ **FEATURES**

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✔ Automatic item cleanup by timer

✔ Warning messages before cleanup

✔ Manual cleanup command

✔ Removal of invisible ArmorStands

✔ World-based cleanup filters

✔ Item filters (ignore named or glowing items)

✔ Anti-lag system with suspicious chunk detection

✔ Optional automatic actions against lag machines

✔ Admin notifications (chat & console)

✔ Lightweight and fully configurable

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**COMPATIBILITY**

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✔ Minecraft versions: 1.18 – 1.21.x

✔ Servers: Spigot / Paper / Purpur / Airplane

✔ Java: 17+

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

⚠ **NOTES**

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

• On Spigot servers TPS values may be shown as N/A

• TPS-based anti-lag features work best on Paper-based servers

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**COMMANDS**

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

/lamaclearitems – manual cleanup

/lamaclearitems reload – reload configuration

/lamaclearitems tps – show server TPS

/lamareload – reload plugin

/lamatps – show server TPS

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**PERMISSIONS**

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

lamaclearitems.use

lamaclearitems.reload

lamaclearitems.tps

lamaclearitems.alert

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**CONFIGURATION**

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

All settings are available in config.yml:

• cleanup intervals and warnings

• world and item filters

• anti-lag thresholds

• automatic actions

• admin notifications

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

❤️ **SUPPORT**

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

If you like the plugin, you can support development via DonationAlerts.
